label: Flora
description: Plant subjects (Civitai 'flower' category) — botany an editor could caption.

items.name: sakura-full-bloom
items.text: cherry trees at absolute peak bloom, every crown opening in the same week, the first petals already letting go on the lightest air

items.name: wildflower-meadow
items.text: an alpine meadow in its brief high-summer flush, gentian, arnica and campion packed shoulder to shoulder, all racing to set seed before September snow

items.name: lavender-rows
items.text: lavender rows combing a dry hillside in parallel purple cords, July heat lifting the oil scent in a visible shimmer, every spike bending under bees

items.name: ancient-oak
items.text: a solitary ancient oak, crown wider than tall, lower limbs sagging to rest their elbows on the grass, dead stag-headed branches crowning five centuries of growth

items.name: lotus-pond
items.text: pink lotus blooms standing a meter above still dark water, rain beading into mercury drops and rolling off the unwettable leaves

items.name: sunflower-field
items.text: a sunflower field in disciplined unison, every mature head locked facing east where the young plants once tracked the sun

items.name: moss-world
items.text: a macro moss world of star rosettes and cushion domes still holding yesterday's rain, spore capsules periscoping above on copper-wire stalks

items.name: autumn-maple
items.text: a Japanese maple in full crimson against dark cedar, its finely cut leaves turning from the crown downward, a fallen red skirt doubling the tree on the moss

items.name: wisteria-tunnel
items.text: a wisteria tunnel in full May cascade, meter-long flower chains opening from the top down so each one grades violet into green bud at the tip

items.name: single-rose
items.text: a single garden rose holding rain in its nested spiral of petals, every velvet edge beaded, each drop lensing the color beneath it

items.name: saguaro-sentinels
items.text: saguaro sentinels raising candelabra arms against a pastel sky — no arm before its seventieth year — pleated ribs swollen full with stored monsoon rain

items.name: fern-unfurl
items.text: a fern fiddlehead unfurling in a perfect logarithmic spiral, fine ginger fuzz on the coil, spring's fastest architecture caught mid-turn

items.name: giant-waterlily
items.text: giant Amazon waterlily pads two meters across, upturned rims ribbed like boat hulls, tiling the still backwater

items.name: dandelion-clock
items.text: a dandelion seed head backlit into a sphere of glass filaments, the first seeds already parachuting away

items.name: bristlecone-pine
items.text: a bristlecone pine at the treeline, dead wood spiraled like driftwood around the one living strip of bark
